ok I need to vent for a sec because I am SO pissed.

Deb sent me a listing tonight for a sticker called “Knife Moth Vinyl Decal” from StickerBurrow Co. its $6.50 or 3 for $15 and it is my switchblade moth. not a moth that kinda looks like mine. MY moth.

I drew that design for the sept 13 flash day and posted the sheet on aug 30. spent like 3 weekends at my kitchen table drawing that whole sheet and the switchblade moth was my favorite thing on it. somebody got it tattooed in the first hour and I was so excited to see it go home with someone who loved it.

this sticker has the same wing pattern. the same little crack in the blade. they didnt even flip it. its not “inspired by” my drawing, its a straight scan of my linework being sold as a sticker.

I messaged them and said hey, thats my design, I have the original drawing and the post from aug 30, please take it down. I didnt give anyone permission to print it. their response was basically “love your work!” followed by moths are a common motif and they cant remove listings based on similarity. and if I have a registered copyright I can send it through their support form. have a great day!

yeah moths are common. a moth with MY wing pattern and MY exact little crack in the blade is not a coincidence. come on.

and to the person wearing this tattoo: no, I am not selling stickers of it. I didnt sell your tattoo to anybody and I didnt give this company permission to use it. I know you paid for a one of one and thats exactly what you should have gotten. Im so sorry you had to see it on a sticker and wonder if it was me.

my flash is sold ONE time to ONE person. thats the whole deal. once somebody gets it, its theirs to wear and I dont tattoo it on anyone else. people trust me when I say that and they pay for it. having somebody else slap the drawing on a sticker doesnt just feel shitty for me, it affects the person who trusted me with their tattoo too.

small artists and shops dont have lawyer money to chase down every sticker place selling their work and these places know it. its exhausting having to spend your night trying to prove you drew the thing you literally drew.

if you have a minute please report the “Knife Moth Vinyl Decal” listing on StickerBurrow Co and please dont buy from them. not asking anybody to harass anyone, just report the listing. thank you Deb for sending it to me even though I know that wasnt a fun message to send lol

ok rant over. gonna go be mad somewhere else for a while.
